title: plugin-view / app-shell / plugin-designer suites escape to the real network on the grid's record-level explain probe (ECONNREFUSED noise, same class as #3339)
body:
Recorded while implementing objectui#4296 (the row kebab folding the record-level write verdict). **Introduced by that change, not pre-existing** — measured 0 before, non-zero after — and handled inside `plugin-grid` there, but the same escape lands in the consumer packages, which are outside that card's declared file surface. Filing rather than editing them.

Same class as objectui#3339 (plugin-detail, closed by PR #4105) and objectui#4106 (plugin-charts / plugin-dashboard). **All suites pass** — this is noise-level hygiene, with the flakiness argument #3339 already made.

## Mechanism

`ObjectGrid` now batches a record-grained write verdict for the rows on screen: `POST /api/v1/security/explain` with `recordIds`, one call per (object, operation). The probe rides `apiFetch ?? fetch`, matching `useRecordEditable` exactly — the global fallback is deliberate, so a standalone same-origin embed's kebab still agrees with its detail header rather than silently keeping the old fail-open rendering.

Under happy-dom that global fallback is a REAL request to the default origin. A suite that renders a grid with an `objectName` and rows carrying ids, without a host `apiFetch` in the tree, therefore fires live requests that fail fire-and-forget: the hook swallows the rejection in order to fail open, so the suite stays green while stderr fills with

```
Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:3000
    at TCPConnectWrap.afterConnect [as oncomplete] (node:net:1637:16)
```

Consumer packages see it because the root `vitest.config.mts` aliases `@object-ui/plugin-grid` to `packages/plugin-grid/src`, so they run against the source, not a built `dist`.

## Measured (worktree of objectui#4296, on top of `b8818171f`)

| suite | result | ECONNREFUSED lines |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/plugin-view/` | 11 files / 111 tests pass | 96 |
| `packages/app-shell/` + `packages/plugin-designer/` | 409 files / 3843 tests pass | 180 |
| `packages/plugin-grid/` (fixed in that PR) | 72 files / 645 tests pass | 0 (was 180) |

Baseline with the fold reverted: `packages/plugin-grid/` was 0, so every line here is attributable to this probe and to nothing else.

## Suggested direction

The remedy is already settled by PR #4105 and reused in objectui#4296: answer the probe from a recorded test double, not from the network and **not** from a global error sink. `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/explainDouble.ts` is a ready-made one — it answers only the explain endpoint, records every URL it is handed so an escape elsewhere stays observable, and returns `visible: true` for every id so a consuming suite's existing assertions keep measuring what they measured before. Consumer packages can import it or copy it; the per-package copy is what #4105 did.

Locating the affected files is a grep for suites rendering `ObjectView` / the app shell with an `objectName` plus id-carrying rows, then `installExplainDouble()` in `beforeEach` and `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` in `afterEach`.

Not a blocker for objectui#4296: the tests pass either way, and the alternative (dropping the global-fetch fallback) would reintroduce the kebab-vs-detail-header contradiction that card fixes, for every same-origin host that does not wire `apiFetch`.
